pages.content: Welcome to Acme Corp. Standard working hours are 09:00 to 17:30 Monday through Friday with a 1-hour lunch break.
Annual paid leave is 18 days per calendar year. Unused leave up to 5 days may be carried over to Q1 of the following year.
Remote work policy allows up to 3 days per week working from home with manager approval. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00.
Health insurance covers employees and up to 2 dependents starting from day 1 of employment. Dental and vision are included.
Expense reimbursements must be submitted within 30 days via the Finance portal with itemized receipts.
Parental leave provides 16 weeks of fully paid leave for primary caregivers and 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.
Learning and development budget is $1,500 per employee per year for courses, books, and conferences.
Resignation notice period is 30 calendar days for individual contributors and 60 calendar days for managers.
Starter plan costs $29 per month and includes up to 5 team members and 10 GB of storage.
Pro plan costs $99 per month and includes up to 25 team members, 100 GB storage, and priority email support.
Enterprise plan offers custom pricing, SSO/SAML authentication, dedicated account manager, and 99.95% uptime SLA.
Refunds are available within 14 days of the initial annual subscription purchase. Monthly plans are non-refundable after renewal.
SLA credits: 10% monthly credit if uptime falls below 99.95%, and 25% credit if uptime falls below 99.0%.
Overdue invoices incur a 1.5% monthly late fee after a 15-day grace period.
All production databases must enforce encryption at rest using AES-256 and TLS 1.3 in transit.
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for all employees accessing cloud consoles, Git repositories, and VPN.
Severity 1 security incidents must be reported to the Security Operations Center within 15 minutes of detection.
API keys and service role secrets must never be committed to source control or exposed in client-side bundles.
Access logs and audit trails are retained for a minimum of 365 days in immutable storage.
Customer data deletion requests under GDPR must be fulfilled within 30 calendar days.
